title: The Cigna Group's Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Details

body_markdown:
BLOOMFIELD, Conn.


, Oct. 9, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Global health company The Cigna Group (NYSE:CI) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, and will host a conference call the same day.


Third quarter 2026 financial results will be released no later than 6:30 a.m. Eastern Time (ET). Management will review these results on a conference call beginning at 8:30 a.m. ET. The call-in numbers are as follows:


**Live Call** **(888) 566-1889 (Domestic)** **(773) 799-3989 (International)** **Passcode: 11052026** **Replay** **(866) 405-7290 (Domestic)** **(203) 369-0603 (International)**


It is strongly suggested that participants dial in to the conference call by 8:15 a.m. ET on November 5, 2026. A replay of the call will be available from 12:30 p.m. ET on November 5, 2026 until 10:59 p.m. ET on November 19, 2026. Additionally, the conference call will be available on a live internet webcast at[https://investors.thecignagroup.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793229-1&h=1304847828&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx) in the Investor Relations section of The Cigna Group's website. Please note that this feature will be in listen-only mode.


A copy of the company's news release and financial supplement will be available on The Cigna Group's website in the Investor Relations section at[https://investors.thecignagroup.com/overview/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793229-1&h=3044282056&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx) , no later than 6:30 a.m. ET on November 5, 2026.


**About The Cigna Group** The Cigna Group (NYSE:CI) is a global health company committed to creating a better future built on the vitality of every individual and every community. We relentlessly challenge ourselves to partner and innovate solutions for better health. The Cigna Group includes products and services marketed under Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth Health Services or its subsidiaries. The Cigna Group maintains sales capabilities in more than 30 markets and jurisdictions, and has over 180 million customer relationships around the world. Learn more at[thecignagroup.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793229-1&h=3406440213&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.thecignagroup.com%2F&a=thecignagroup.com) .
